title: Lispico project configuration
description: Version-2 declarative configuration for the Lispico language server and checker. Place as `.lispico.json` at the worktree root, or select a different file with the server's `project_file` initialization option. All relative paths resolve from the containing file's directory. File globs use `/` as the separator, `*` within a path segment, and `**` across segments; excludes win over inclusions, and every executable source file must match exactly one context. The configuration is never executed and no ancestor or home-directory scan is performed.

runtime_version.description: Expected go-lispico version (for example "0.14.0") or recorded source revision the analysis should match.

relative_path.description: Canonical relative path: `/` separators, no leading slash, no drive letter, no backslash, and no empty, `.`, or `..` segments.

glob.description: Relative glob: `/` separator, `*` within a segment, `**` across segments.

catalog.description: A local declaration catalog with the expected provenance it must match. Missing or mismatched catalogs produce one actionable context diagnostic; the tooling never silently selects a newer catalog.

path.description: Catalog file path, relative to this configuration file.

owner.description: Owning project or module, for example "zhk" or "yagel".

expected_version.description: Expected release version recorded in the catalog's source provenance.

expected_revision.description: Expected source revision recorded in the catalog's source provenance.

expected_fingerprint.description: Additionally pins a development snapshot's source fingerprint.

source_root.description: Optional checkout used to verify the catalog's declared source-file fingerprints; without it the catalog is verified as catalog-only provenance.

context.description: One executable-source context. Context `files` globs must not overlap another context's; overlap is a configuration error, not a priority rule. The selected language ID and `dialect` must agree.

dialect.description: Lispico dialect of the context's sources: `cl` (Lisp-2, bracket literals disabled) or `clojure` (Lisp-1, bracket literals enabled).

profile.description: Host loading model applied to the context's sources.

libraries.description: Enabled library IDs; locating a library on disk does not enable it.

source_roots.description: Roots permitted for indexing; indexing never implies import or global visibility. Scans are bounded, symlinks are not followed, and external roots require these explicit paths.

prelude.description: Ordered prelude globs evaluated before each sequential program (zhk profile only).

layers.description: Ordered overlay layers; later entries shadow earlier ones by relative file identity (Yagel profiles only).

layer.description: One Yagel overlay layer. `embedded` reads the runtime's embedded sources; the other kinds read `root`. Later layers shadow earlier ones; a winning unreadable or invalid file never falls back to a lower layer.

root.description: Layer source root, relative to this configuration file. Required for global and project; packs layers choose either `root` (live directory) or the locked snapshot pair.

snapshot.description: Installed-pack snapshot document path, relative to this configuration file. Packs layers only: allowed only together with expected_fingerprint, and forbidden together with root.

expected_fingerprint.description: Expected SHA-256 fingerprint of the snapshot's verified source content. Packs layers only: pins the selected snapshot and is forbidden on other layer kinds.

allOf.description: A packs layer is either a live root directory or a locked snapshot with its expected fingerprint — never both, never neither.
